failure_mode_analysis.small_litter_items: Items smaller than 16x16 pixels (cigarette butts, pins, tiny wrappers) may fall below YOLOv8n receptive field resolution.
failure_mode_analysis.partial_occlusion: Litter partially hidden beneath benches, behind pillars, or in tall grass exhibits reduced feature visibility.
failure_mode_analysis.shadows_and_lighting: Harsh afternoon sun and deep shadows on concrete can cause false positive shadows or false negative missed items.
failure_mode_analysis.textured_backgrounds: Dry leaves, pebbles, and speckled terrazzo tiles can occasionally trigger false detections.
failure_mode_analysis.motion_blur: Low-quality camera shots or moving captures blur high-frequency edges necessary for litter classification.
